A dungeon fight's board rail now shows the modifier chip (`ModifierList`, R169) whenever a modifier is live on either side. Tapping it opens every label in full: yours under "You" and the enemy's under the enemy's translated name. With no modifier live, no chip renders. - **`apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx`**: `matchStatus` is now a fragment. `<ModifierList view={snapshot.view} opponentLabel={enemy} />` comes first, then the unchanged `dungeon-fight__status` span. `enemy` is the existing `t(setup.enemy.name)`. The header comment is updated.

  - the enemy's modifiers: listed under "Cave Troll", the same text as `fightTestid.enemy`;
  - both sides: counted together and listed under both names;
  - no modifiers: no chip and no panel.
- **`apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/fight.css`**: only the comment above `.dungeon-fight__status` changed. No CSS rule changed.

  - a new ruling, `spec/rulings/R3912000.md`, proven in `FightScreen.test.tsx`;
